question: What serves as the sixth element in the sixfold installation across all cases?
premises: The mantra that is invoked is endowed with its limbs.
That invoked mantra constitutes the sixth element.
This rule applies in all cases.
inference: In every case, the invoked mantra together with its limbs functions as the sixth part of the sixfold installation.
plain_english: But the mantra that is invoked, endowed with its limbs, should be the sixth. Thus in all cases this installation is stated as sixfold.
